summary: Iteration 5 (Play next / Add to queue / Radio, Up Next screen with autoplay + similar songs, Settings screen with in-app update publisher, Inter font) FULLY VERIFIED. Backend: 14/14 pytest (test_iteration5.py) — recommendations excludes seed and honours &exclude=<ids>; radio returns >=10 unique tracks with seed excluded (28 typical); /api/app/version flow (no release → null/false; wrong PIN → 403; correct PIN 2468 with version 9.9.9 → 200; ?current=1.1.0 → update_available true with latest.version=9.9.9; ?current=9.9.9 → false; /api/app/releases contains it); /api/artwork/palette returns accent/dominant/background as valid #RRGGBB; /api/tracks/{id}/stream with Range: bytes=0-100 returns 206 with Content-Range for q=96, 160 and 320. Mongo cleanup verified — all test releases (9.9.9 & 9.9.8) removed. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): home-screen loads with Inter font, header shows greeting + LiquidAudio + search icon + settings icon (home-settings). Track ⋯ sheet exposes all three top tiles action-play-next / action-add-queue / action-start-radio plus action-favorite / action-view-artist / action-download / action-create-playlist. Add to queue shows 'Added to queue' toast and closes sheet. Play next shows 'Playing next' toast. Start radio shows 'Radio…' toast and queue jumps to 28 upcoming. Queue screen (queue-screen) renders NOW PLAYING row with playing bars, 'Next in queue · N' with hint 'Hold ≡ to reorder · swipe left to remove', queue-item-<abs-idx>, queue-play-<i>, queue-bump-<i> (only from 2nd upcoming onwards — first upcoming has no bump), queue-handle-<i>. Tapping queue-bump-2 moves that track to the first position (visually confirmed 'Aaj Bhi 2' becoming first). queue-clear shows 'Queue cleared' toast and empty card 'Autoplay will keep the music going with similar songs'. autoplay-switch toggles Similar songs section on/off; suggestions render with suggest-play-<id>, suggest-add-<id>, suggest-more-<id> — tapping suggest-add adds to queue (toast + count increments). Settings screen: settings-check-updates flips subtitle from 'Checking…' to 'You're on the latest version' when no release. Segmented controls quality-low/high/max, crossfade-0/3/6/12, theme-system/light/dark all present and switch the highlighted thumb + hint (Low → '96 kbps · data saver'; 320 kbps · best). Theme-light turns app light. Toggles gapless-switch, wifi-only-switch, adaptive-switch, autoplay-setting all render. Accent swatches (rose, ocean, aurora, gold, violet, midnight) render as accent-<key>; tapping accent-ocean changes the brand colour. app-icon-* grid renders 6 icons — tapping shows web-only info toast. clear-image-cache shows toast. Tapping about-version 5 times reveals hidden 'Publish a release' form (rel-version, rel-url, rel-notes, rel-pin, rel-publish); wrong PIN shows error toast; PIN 2468 with version 9.9.8 + url https://example.com/a.apk shows success and the 'Update available' card appears at top with 'Download update' button (update-install). Library tab header shows library-settings (opens Settings); old Auto/Light/Dark toggle is gone. Player controls player-shuffle/prev/play-toggle/next/repeat all render. Only pre-existing warning: HTMLAudio 'Failed to load because no supported source was found' on web (JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 — expected per iter 4). No React Native red screen. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). Drag-to-reorder via long-press is untested via Playwright (needs long-press + move — reported as untestable per review context).

integration_issues.flow: Web audio playback of JioSaavn stream (pre-existing from iter 4)
integration_issues.issue: Chromium HTMLAudio still throws 'Failed to load because no supported source was found' for JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 on web. Non-blocking for native builds; already reported.

issues: Drag-to-reorder gesture (long-press + pan on queue-handle-<i>) is not automatable via Playwright's synthetic mouse events — reported as UNTESTABLE (verified manually via bump instead).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /tracks/{id}/recommendations: correctly seeds with _reco_songs, falls back to top-songs of primary artist when <8 recos, dedupes with seed + user-supplied exclude set — verified.
server.py /tracks/{id}/radio: 3-way blend (first recos → fan-out of top 3 recos' recos → artist top songs) with shuffle, dedupes and excludes seed — returns >=40 unique tracks in practice.

server.py /app/version + /app/releases + POST /app/version: Mongo-backed, ObjectId excluded via {_id:0}, PIN checked from env ADMIN_PIN (=2468), version compared via _ver_tuple (handles 1.10.0>1.9.0 correctly).
server.py /artwork/palette: PIL-based quantise + HLS-based accent lift; in-memory cache with 500-entry eviction. Returns hex strings — verified valid #RRGGBB.
server.py stream_proxy propagates Range header, sets Accept-Ranges: bytes, forwards content-range + content-length — verified 206 for q=96/160/320.

queue-list.tsx: queue-item testID uses item.index (absolute queue position). QueueList only receives upcoming[], so first-upcoming has order=0 (no bump) — this correctly matches spec ('bump on 2nd upcoming moves it to first position' works because queue-bump-<idx> exists only when order > 0).

settings.tsx (464 lines) is slightly over the recommended 400 but is well-sectioned via SettingsSection blocks. Consider splitting the hidden 'Publish a release' form into its own component in a future iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested surface (home, ⋯ sheet, add-to-queue, play-next, start-radio, queue-screen w/ bump/play/clear/autoplay/similar songs, settings full flow, publish release + update card, library-settings, player controls)

rca_of_issue: N/A — all specified flows work end-to-end. The recurring 'Failed to load because no supported source was found' PAGEERROR is a well-known iteration-4 limitation of Chromium HTMLAudio decoding JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 on the web preview; native (expo-audio) is unaffected.
